podcast.body: The band's eighth album, recorded intermittently over a period exceeding a year and a half before its release on May 12, 2014. Similar to how *Brothers* was influenced by Patrick Carney's divorce, *Turn Blue* was informed by Dan Auerbach's divorce, with lyrical themes reflecting this personal experience. The album's existence was announced by Mike Tyson via a tweet. Its title is an homage to Gullardi, a Cleveland late-night horror movie host from the 1960s, whose catchphrase inspired it. The cover art also references Gullardi's interest in films exploring mind control, brainwashing, and hypnotism. Five singles were released from the album. "Turn blue, the eighth album, was recorded in fits and starts over more than a year and a half before being released on May 12, 2014."
